mintAuthority.summary: The tracked UTY deployment mints collateralized vault shares from USDC on Base and uses LayerZero OFTs on Avalanche and Katana. All three UTY contracts are UUPS proxies owned without delay by the same EOA; Base's mutable maxTotalAssets cap is currently uint256 max and can be changed independently by any of three EOA MANAGER_ROLE members.

controls.evidence: At Base block 48619333, Avalanche block 90284859, and Katana block 37285133, owner() on the tracked UTY proxy returned 0xA695bB4B... on every chain and eth_getCode for that owner was empty. review.evidence: The prior record described legacy Avalanche token 0xdbc5192a..., which is not the address tracked in the deployment registry. Live RPC review of the tracked 0xba515304... address found three distinct UUPS implementations with the same EOA owner on Base, Avalanche, and Katana. Verified Base source established the collateralized mint path, mutable cap, enumerable manager set, and owner-only upgrade path; project docs establish Base as the vault hub and Avalanche/Katana as OFT spokes. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the common owner EOA can replace mint logic and manager EOAs can raise the Base cap without delay; Accountable telemetry does not prove liability reconciliation across both OFT spokes and is not independent supervision.
